choices.text: I really didn't expect you all to be here...

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: A little over-the-top, huh? Haha... But hey, telling you in advance would've ruined the surprise.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Judging from the photos, it looks like everyone's really excited about this vacation!

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: It might be quite a short vacation for me, but still — I'd like to take this chance to unwind.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: So... What's the most challenging attraction at the resort? Any recommendations?

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Oh, on to the weather now, are we?

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: There's been a cool, pleasant breeze blowing through the resort lately... Quite uncommon around these parts, I'd say...

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: It would be great if this particular "breeze" could stick around in Natlan for a few more days.

choices.text: Hope you enjoy your vacation too, Mavuika.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Hehe, thanks! I hope you and all your friends have a great time too.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: So, how about it? Now that you're all done, we can finally have a proper drink together, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Haha, you make it sound like I was holding out on you...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: But if you and I had a real drinking bout, I don't think these poor little aphids could handle it. They'd have to flit to and fro making mead till their wings gave way!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Haha, spoken like a true bard! That impromptu toast you gave just now was spot on too.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: "For happiness and freedom"... Couldn't have said it better myself. That's exactly what we all need right now.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: You must have been to your fair share of banquets in Mondstadt, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Of course — they don't call it "The City of Wine and Song" for nothing! Besides, without being able to come up with a decent toast, how else might a humble bard earn themselves a regular supply of free Dandelion Wine?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Haha... Well, when you're free, you're always welcome at our tribal banquets. They'll be fighting over who gets to host you, I guarantee it!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Just so you know, they can get pretty rowdy. Banging, stomping, belting out off-key drinking songs... stuff like that. You wouldn't mind, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Of course not, that sounds like great fun! Ah, if only our two nations could throw a joint banquet someday...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Great idea! I'll make sure to load up a few extra barrels of Aphimead for the occasion.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: As it happens, the Collective of Plenty recently launched a new drink called a "Quenepacano"... I'll make sure to bring some for you and your friends to try out too.
